title: Second Giza scan paper under peer review

tellings.quote: So, in this moment we are working on a scientific paper.

plain: Filippo Biondi, an Italian scientist who uses satellite radar to look underground, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2025 his team is working on a second scientific paper about their scan beneath the Khafre pyramid at Giza in Egypt. He says the paper is under review by other scientists, and it ties to his team's claim that the pyramid's limestone soaks up the radar signal from its known chambers. If accepted, it would give formal backing to their claims about hidden structures under the pyramid.
